config.policy: Candidates and primary frozen on validation before test. No test-based model selection.

candidates.policy: Three highest validation CIDEr-D rows from the completed common batch64 search, fixed before test inference. Primary winner stays validation-selected. No test-based reselection.
candidates.pretraining_limitation: The project test comes from COCO train2017, which was used for detector pretraining. It is caption-decoder-held-out, not unseen by the complete pretrained visual system.

detector_contract.input: EXIF-transposed RGB; ToTensor float32 in [0,1]; original aspect ratio and size
detector_contract.selection: Final class-NMS detections, score filter, class-agnostic NMS, descending score, top K
detector_contract.feature_layer: box_roi_pool + TwoMLPHead.fc6/ReLU/fc7/ReLU, rerun on selected FINAL boxes
detector_contract.feature_storage_dtype: float16 after finite/overflow validation; compute and returned features remain float32
detector_contract.boxes: xyxy in original EXIF-transposed RGB pixel coordinates; zero padding
detector_contract.boxes_normalized: xyxy divided by original [width,height,width,height]; reporting only
detector_contract.mask: bool; True means a real selected region, including the full-image fallback
detector_contract.fallback: If no boxes remain, ROI-pool the full transformed image; valid count=1, score=0, label=-1, fallback=True
detector_contract.decoder_inputs: visual features and valid-region mask only; no predicted class labels, scores or object words
detector_contract.test_exposure_note: COCO detector pretraining may include train2017 images used by the captioning holdout; do not claim an unseen-image encoder test.

region_config.selection: All saved labeled test IDs, sorted; no image or caption selection.
region_config.pretraining_limitation: COCO detector pretraining includes train2017. These images are held out from caption-decoder training, not from the complete pretrained visual system.

cider_d.scale: native score, including the implementation's factor 10; no extra multiplication
cider_d.document_frequency: all reference sets in the evaluated split

tokenization.name: project_regex_v1
tokenization.note: Same tokenizer for predictions and raw references; not COCO leaderboard PTB tokenization.
